messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — packaging cutover scheduled 02:00-03:00 UTC tonight. Quick check: transport lanes, cosign, and escort concurrency all green?
Aj Patel: I ran a dry-run earlier. packaging-cutover-script v2 passed local checks but mirror backfill lagged on lane-2 (~6m). still within SLA?
Sasha K: Lane-2 lag is from vendor mirror throttling, saw 429 spikes. We have a backoff in the script but we should limit concurrent escorts to 3 to avoid cascading retries.
Tom O'Neill: Agree. Set CONCURRENCY=3 for the runbook. If lane-2 falls behind >10m, abort canary and fallback to last-sealed-manifest.
Packaging Squad: Checklist update: 1) sign manifest with cosign (KMS key kms-prod-1), 2) push sealed OCI bundle to transport-lane-1, lane-2, 3) publish shrinkwrap index, 4) update release notes with pinned image tags.
Maria Chen: For cosign TTL — Aj, can key signer rotate within the window? we need signer-stable for 30m post-cutover.
Aj Patel: signer rotation will be paused. cosign sigs are deterministic; we'll record signature digest in release notes: sig:sha256:abcd1234...
DeployBot: preflight checks ok: transports (1/2/3) reachable, checksum match ok, cosign verify ok. Dry-run log: ```2026-03-20T23:45:12Z packaging-cutover-script v2: preflight ok
mirror-lag lane-2: 360s
cosign verify: OK (key id kms-prod-1)```
Sasha K: If cosign verify fails during cutover, fallback is: 1) stop propagation to remaining lanes, 2) revert pushed bundle on lanes that accepted it (use `transportctl revoke`), 3) alert security and open incident.
Tom O'Neill: Rollback criteria spelled out: - checksum mismatch on >1% of nodes OR lane lag >15m OR deploybot exit code !=0 for canary. On rollback, we will unpin index and re-open previous sealed-manifest.
Maria Chen: Release notes snippet for ops: "Private/VPC onprem: v2026.03.20 private-installer: image tags pinned, cosign sig recorded, limit escort concurrency to 3. Canary window 15m." I'll paste final in the docs repo post-cutover.
Packaging Squad: Heads-up: we'll run canary on 3 staging customers first (seeded), wait 12m, then full fanout if no regressions. If any regression, set emergency-unpin true and run rollback playbook.
DeployBot: canary started (job id job-4256-canary). status: running. logs streaming -> https://deploybot.internal/logs/job-4256-canary
Aj Patel: One more: please ensure the shrinkwrap index has immutable tags (avoid latest). use `sha256:` pinned references only.
Maria Chen: noted. I'll kick at 02:00UTC. call @oncall if deploybot shows >10% token errors. :thumbsup:
Sasha K: Cool — I'll watch lane-2 and be ready to cut concurrency to 1 if we see more 429s.
Tom O'Neill: I'll prepare rollback playbook PR and keep the runbook open. good luck!
